This week’s highlights: Securitize brings sports equity onchain; the SEC looks to modernize; Carlos joins The Crypto Tape; Securitize and VARA sign MoU; HINC becomes collateral on Solana's Loopscale; and Giang Bui joins The Rollup. City AM NYSE-listed Securitize Offer Football Club Shares on Blockchain with Socios Securitize and Socios.com have partnered to offer regulated, tokenized minority stakes in professional sports teams. This offering will combine Securitize’s securities infrastructure with Socios.com’s club relationships and fan engagement platform. READ MORE Stocktwits SEC Targets Blockchain Era With Transfer Agent Rule Overhaul As Wall Street Ramps Up Tokenization The SEC proposed updating decades-old transfer agent rules to reflect electronic communications and blockchain-based securities systems. The proposal could give tokenized securities a clearer framework for recording ownership and transferring shares on distributed ledgers. READ MORE GSR The Transfer-Agent Bet and the Road to Onchain Equities with Carlos Domingo Carlos Domingo, Co-founder and CEO, discusses Securitize’s expanding range of tokenized investment products, the critical role of transfer agents, tokenized IPO access, and blockchain’s potential to transform shareholder engagement. WATCH NOW Cointelegraph VARA, Securitize Sign MoU for Tokenization Innovation in Dubai Dubai’s Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) and Securitize signed an MoU to foster more tokenization innovation and identify where collaboration can help support the development of trusted, regulated tokenized projects in Dubai. READ MORE The Defiant Securitize's HINC Becomes Collateral on Solana's Loopscale Securitize’s HINC is now accepted as collateral on Solana-based lending protocol Loopscale, allowing eligible investors to borrow USDG without redeeming their fund shares. READ MORE The Rollup Giang Bui on Expanding Onchain Investment Access Securitize Head of Issuer Growth, Giang Bui, discusses growing demand for tokenized investment options beyond Treasuries, including the new Neuberger Securitize High Income Tokenized Fund.
